verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a workflow-automation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Zapier's hosted service, and nothing shows the core product can be self-hosted. The local SDK, CLI and MCP-server packages (zapier-docs-4, zapier-docs-26) are client-side tools that still rely on Zapier's cloud, so they are adjacent rather than self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
